integrity: The analytical argument proves the all-composite-length statement. Included finite computations independently check exact Gram identities and frequencies in small cases; no independent mathematical audit or outside validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats only uniform indexed primitive binary words and the first coordinate Walsh band; it does not cover canonical unrotated representatives, nonuniform measures, or higher Walsh orders. Historical priority is provisional because an equivalent older ensemble covariance calculation might exist.
title: A Möbius–Fourier frame law for primitive cyclic binary words
